about_the_game:
No more mindless clicking.

Experience a universe-scale growth game where Clicker + RPG + Strategy + Story come together.

🧠 Beyond simple clicks, control the flow of battle with pattern analysis, skill builds, and equipment combinations to defeat countless bosses.

🌟 Features
• Click-based combat combined with key inputs
• Thousands of skill & equipment combinations
• Over 30 unique boss fights (patterns, status effects, traps, and more)
• Original battle BGM

💥 This game is not about raw DPS.
Victory depends on your decisions and strategies in the moment.

📌 Genre: Hyper Clicker, Strategy RPG, Survival Growth Game
📌 Platform: Single-player (PC only)
📌 Languages: Korean / English / Japanese

Upcoming Updates & Future Job Structure

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 이상
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra 이상
  • Processor: Apple Silicon 또는 Intel
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 6100+, 2.0GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520+
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8100+ (8250U)+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 or GPU (GTX 750+)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: A hyper clicker that combines control and strategy! From casual play to extreme difficulty, anyone can take on the challenge. Experience a vast adventure and endless leveling created by a solo developer!
